theorem amc12_2001_p5 :
  Finset.prod (Finset.filter (λ x => ¬ Even x) (Finset.range 10000)) (id : ℕ → ℕ) = (10000!) / ((2^5000) * 5000!) := by
  have h : Finset.prod (Finset.filter (λ x => ¬ Even x) (Finset.range 10000)) (id : ℕ → ℕ) = (Finset.range 10000).prod id / (Finset.prod (Finset.filter (λ x => Even x) (Finset.range 10000)) (id : ℕ → ℕ)) := by
    rw [Finset.prod_filter]
    <;> simp [Finset.prod_range_succ, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.factorial_zero]
  rw [h]
  have h₁ : (Finset.range 10000).prod id = 10000! := by
    simp [Finset.prod_range_succ, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.factorial_zero]
  have h₂ : (Finset.filter (λ x => Even x) (Finset.range 10000)).prod (id : ℕ → ℕ) = (2^5000) * 5000! := by
    have h₃ : (Finset.filter (λ x => Even x) (Finset.range 10000)).prod (id : ℕ → ℕ) = (Finset.range 5000).prod (λ i => 2 * i) := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro x hx
      simp [Nat.even_iff, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt] at hx ⊢
      <;> omega
    rw [h₃]
    have h₄ : (Finset.range 5000).prod (λ i => 2 * i) = (2^5000) * (Finset.range 5000).prod (λ i => i) := by
      simp [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    rw [h₄]
    have h₅ : (Finset.range 5000).prod (λ i => i) = 5000! := by
      simp [Finset.prod_range_succ, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.factorial_zero]
    rw [h₅]
  rw [h₁, h₂]
  <;> field_simp
  <;> ring
  <;> norm_num

theorem mathd_numbertheory_1124

    have h₉ : n ≤ 9 := h₀
